2611.28686.title: PopMelodyGen: A Copyright-Aware Platform for Controllable Pop-Melody Generation
2611.28686.paper_summary: Large-scale redistributable symbolic pop-melody data remain scarce due to copyright restrictions, creating a bottleneck for both practical deployment and reproducible research in music generation. We present PopMelodyGen, a copyright-aware platform for controllable pop-melody generation that combines rule-based synthesis with neural generation. Our approach first uses an expert synthesizer to produce large-scale labeled synthetic melodies from explicit musical knowledge and templates, providing scalable pretraining data with auditable provenance. A neural model is then pretrained on this corpus and adapted with a small licensed real-pop corpus to improve melodic naturalness while preserving controllability. The platform supports interactive melody creation with accompaniment playback and export for creators, as well as batch construction of annotated symbolic datasets for researchers. PopMelodyGen demonstrates a practical training and deployment paradigm for creative AI when large-scale reusable real-world data are limited.
